## WorkerThreadInit.onBeforeExit() method

Hook called before the worker is shut down gracefully.

**Signature:**

```typescript
onBeforeExit(): void | Promise<void>;
```
**Returns:**

void \| Promise&lt;void&gt;

## Remarks

Invoked by [WorkerThreadInit.shutdown()](./worker-thread.workerthreadinit.shutdown.md) (called via RPC from `WorkerThreadLaunch.shutdown`<!-- -->). Override to flush state, close connections, or persist data. The worker is terminated by the main thread after this hook completes.
